info.name: Palmyst API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Palmyst palm-reading backend.

**Quick Start:**
1. Import this collection + `palmyst.postman_environment.json`
2. Select the **Palmyst Local** environment
3. Run `npx supabase status` and paste the `anon key` into `anon_key`
4. Run **01 - Authentication > Sign In** — `auth_token` and `user_id` are set automatically

**API Layers:**
- Auth: `/auth/v1/`
- REST / RPC: `/rest/v1/` and `/rest/v1/rpc/`
- Edge Functions: `/functions/v1/`
- Storage: `/storage/v1/`

variable.description: Supabase anon key — get from `npx supabase status`

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: User registration, login, and token management.

request.description: Register a new user. Triggers handle_new_user() which creates a profile with 5 welcome credits. Pass a valid `referred_by` profile UUID in `data` to trigger the referral bonus.
Sign in with email + password. Sets auth_token, refresh_token, and user_id automatically.
Create a palm profile. Set palm_image_url after uploading image to Storage.

item.name: 04 - Catalogue
item.description: Read-only lookup tables: categories, languages, tool creators.

request.description: Validates credits and palm ownership, deducts credits, creates session. Returns session UUID. Then call analyze-palm Edge Function immediately.
Deducts 5 credits and returns the solution content. Idempotent — calling again returns content without charging again. p_solution_type: 'traditional' or 'science_backed'.

item.name: Get My Action Progress for Session

request.description: Marks current action as completed and unlocks the next one. p_feeling: felt_good | was_uncomfortable | not_sure_yet.
Create a chat session. Link to a tool_session_id to enable context-aware AI responses.
is_liked: true = liked, false = disliked, null = no rating.
Grants 2 credits for sharing a tool. Rate-limited: once per tool per 24 hours.
First submission earns 3 credits. Subsequent updates earn 0. p_session_id and p_review_text are optional.

exec: console.log('New review:', body.is_new_review, '| Credits earned:', body.credits_earned);

request.description: Returns {valid: true, discount_type, discount_value} or {valid: false, error}. Code is case-insensitive.
RLS auto-filters to banners where is_active=true and within valid_from/valid_until window.

item.name: 15 - Edge Functions
item.description: Supabase Edge Functions running on Deno. Require apikey + Authorization headers.

request.description: Call immediately after start_tool_session. Uses Claude Opus 4.6 vision to analyse palm images. On failure, credits are automatically refunded via trigger.
Send a message and receive an AI response (Claude Haiku 4.5). If the chat session is linked to a completed tool_session, the AI has context of that reading.

Webhook endpoint — called by Stripe or RevenueCat. In production, the signature is auto-computed by the provider. For local testing, use the Stripe CLI: `stripe listen --forward-to http://127.0.0.1:54321/functions/v1/process-payment`.

item.name: 16 - Storage (Palm Images)
item.description: Upload and retrieve palm images from Supabase Storage. Create a bucket named 'palms' in the Storage dashboard first.

request.description: Upload a palm image. After upload, call PATCH /rest/v1/palms to set palm_image_url.

item.name: Get Signed URL for Palm Image

request.description: Generate a signed URL for temporary access to a private palm image (1 hour expiry).
